items.description: A wheeled chair used to move a seated patient between areas of a facility.
items.trainingUse: Identification and orientation. Learners recognise the chair and its main parts: seat, backrest, armrests, footrests and wheels.

Training model - not a medical device specification.

items.description: A pedestal-mounted injector unit of the type used alongside CT scanners. This model is for visual recognition only.

No operation is simulated.
